## Summary

I resolved ticket T-4008 by investigating the root cause of the broken legacy portal redirects. The problem was identified in the ingress-nginx controller logs showing that the `configuration-snippet` annotation was being explicitly skipped because the controller was deployed with `allow-snippet-annotations=false`. This security setting, introduced in the weekend upgrade, disabled the regex-based redirect configuration that the legacy-portal Ingress relies on. The solution requires the platform team to either re-enable snippet annotations or migrate to an alternative redirect mechanism that works with the current security constraints.
